d: The Supreme Court has cleared the way for the Income Tax Department to reopen tax assessments of Chetan and Nitin Sabharwal, sons of former Chief Justice of India Y.K. Sabharwal. The case involves share transactions worth Rs 255 crore in two companies, Pawan Impex and SVIIT Software, in 2007. The department questioned the valuation of these shares and their connection to the brothers' purchase of a prime property on Delhi's Sikandra Road in 2010. A bench of Justices J.B. Pardiwala and K.
